gmdn_terms.name: Coronary angioplasty balloon catheter, basic
gmdn_terms.definition: A flexible tube designed for percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty (PTCA) to dilate a stenotic coronary artery by controlled inflation of a distensible balloon(s) at its distal tip. It is typically available as: 1) an over-the-wire (OTW) type that has a double or triple-lumen, one for the guidewire and one or two for single- or double-balloon inflation; and 2) a rapid exchange (RX) type with a single-lumen. It is available in various sizes for the dilatation of small, narrowed, or obstructed coronary arteries or bypass grafts. It may also be intended for pre- or post-dilatation of a balloon-expandable stent (not included) in the coronary arteries. This is a single-use device.
